summary: Latitude Accountants is a multi-office chartered accounting firm (Melbourne office at 289 Flinders Lane) and Xero Platinum Partner with 2,000+ clients and a team in Tarlac, Philippines. Nathan Lobb, the contact already emailed on 24 Nov 2026, is its Marketing Manager (and Wakewood co-founder), not a firm co-founder as the account record says; he produces the firm's podcasts. John Saade is CEO and was appointed to the RBA Small Business Finance Advisory Panel in 2026.

followUp.body:

Following up on my note earlier this week. Latitude tells clients it is in their corner every month and every quarter, and with more than 2,000 clients and a team in Tarlac, that is a lot of monthly reconciling. Vert cuts it to minutes with a traceable audit trail. Since you run marketing, who looks after the bookkeeping workflow? Happy to speak with them directly.

Best,
